transc:
(140 pm 29)  HdQrs mily Dia Miss Beaufort S. C.
Lt Gen US Grant City Rr Jan. 24. 1865 via N Y. 29.
Denmark yellow I was cackled Kearsarge by refine
to write Yaba Insipid Arago He reached here
lundy from webster & went Kearsarge to Pocket
alleygro to look to matters in person &
proposes Kerosene to husband Salka Hatchie Astonish asa
bolster Kiss & also to then handle until
quadrille gets out to high ground from Sisters
complexion ---- The storm dismal imbibe & continuous
for several Bradys braring franklin by bad hucksters
but now its clear , the homers are 
improving Granite & it bids fair for good
weather ---- I may hear Dana Democrat census
night & will calhoun you further signed L
M Day ton finland & Annapolis ---- ---
